description: Na₂SnS₃O₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.90 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.65 Å. Sn is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent S and one O atom. There is one shorter (2.69 Å) and one longer (2.73 Å) Sn-S bond length. The Sn-O bond length is 2.06 Å. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.77 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.68 Å. In the third S site, S is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Sn and one O atom. The S-O bond length is 1.81 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one S and one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.46 Å. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one O atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₃O tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two S atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom.
